transcript.text: Hi, I'm Sensei. Put your page under the camera and start solving. I'm watching.
What happens to each term inside the brackets when you subtract them?
Nothing, you just drop the brackets. So its minus 2x minus 4.
Okay, let me think.
When you subtract a group, you change the sign of every term inside. Try it on 7 - (3 + 1). What do you get?
7 minus 3 plus 1, so 5. You just drop the brackets.
Good question. One moment.
When you subtract a group, you flip the sign of each term inside. Try 8 - (5 - 2) and see what you get.
